sentences.text: Researchers constructed a high-resolution map of the basal ganglia in humans, rhesus macaques, and common marmosets by analyzing over one million cells from each species, combining spatial gene expression maps with a shared cell-type classification system to reveal how molecules are organized inside and between these brain structures.

Detailed sampling along the front-to-back axis showed that the striatum contains complex but highly consistent multi-directional patterns of gene expression layered over distinct regions, while the analysis also identified a specific core-and-shell structural arrangement within the internal globus pallidus region.
The authors state that this new atlas serves as a fundamental tool for future research into the molecular and functional roles of the basal ganglia in both health and disease.
